Game Link: https://www.roblox.com/games/115545603079164/Car-League
Campaign Goal
Create engaging short-form videos that introduce Car League, showcase the gameplay, and encourage viewers to play it on Roblox.
The main funnel is game visits, using competitive car soccer gameplay, exciting goals, and funny moments to build interest.
Suggested Video Structure
Hook the viewer with an exciting goal, funny moment, or interesting gameplay mechanic, showcase Car League using gameplay footage, and include a CTA to play the game on Roblox near the end.
Creators have freedom over their concept, narration, and editing as long as the video clearly promotes Car League and includes the required CTA.
Requirements
* Only Roblox-focused accounts may upload.
* Videos must be fully focused on Car League only.
* The name "Car League" must be spoken somewhere in the video.
* Include a clear CTA near the end encouraging viewers to play Car League on Roblox.
* Videos must maintain at least a 1% engagement rate.
* Cross-posting to all platforms is suggested.
Main CTA & Game Hooks
Encourage viewers to play Car League on Roblox near the end of the video. Creators can choose which gameplay moments to highlight and how to present the CTA.
The Game
* Car League is a competitive Roblox game where players play soccer using cars (Rocket League Style)
* Drive around the field, use boosts, and hit the ball into the opposing team's goal.
* Challenge friends or compete against other players to become King of the Field.
* Score more goals than your opponents to win the match.


What Players Can Do
* Drive cars around a soccer field and compete to score goals.
* Use boosts to move quickly and hit the ball.
* Join matches by heading to a Duel Pad.
* Make impressive shots, saves, and last-second goals.
You do not need to mention every feature. Pick what fits your video, keep the CTA simple, and use your own wording.
Content Ideas & Hook Examples
These are examples. Original concepts are welcome.
* "Someone made Rocket League in Roblox..."
* "You can literally play Rocket League on Roblox.."
* "I just scored the craziest goal in Car League."
* "Trying to become the best Car League player on Roblox."
* "I challenged my friend to a car soccer match in Roblox."
* "This Roblox game is actually harder than it looks..."
Quality & Approval Standards
* Start with a strong hook and give viewers a reason to keep watching.
* Showcase the game clearly with footage that supports your narration.
* Add original narration, editing, or a clear creative concept.
* Make the CTA easy to understand and follow.
* Low-effort, poorly presented, misleading, or off-topic videos may be rejected.
* Do not invent gameplay features, rewards, or codes.
* Do not present Car League as an official Rocket League game or collaboration.
* Paid promotions and collaborations outside this campaign are not allowed and will be rejected.
Payout
* Budget: $1,500
* CPM: 0.90
* Max Payout: $300 per Submission
